partners.mechanism_chain: CENPF (HGNC:2172) —DISRUPTS→ Centrosome duplication and function; TUBB1 (HGNC:11640) —DISRUPTS→ Microtubule organization and stability; Centrosome duplication and function —LEADS_TO→ Microcephaly (HP:0000252); Microtubule organization and stability —LEADS_TO→ Abnormal megakaryocyte morphology (HP:0030127); Microtubule organization and stability —LEADS_TO→ Thrombocytopenia (HP:0001874); Centrosome duplication and function —BINDS→ Microtubule organization and stability.
